signature: SUBROUTINE DSPGST( ITYPE, UPLO, N, AP, BP, INFO )

params.name: itype
params.reference: -   `= 1`: compute $\operatorname{inv}(U^T) \, A \, \operatorname{inv}(U)$ or $\operatorname{inv}(L) \, A \, \operatorname{inv}(L^T)$; = 2 or 3: compute $U \, A \, U^T$ or $L^T \, A \, L$.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored and B is factored as $U^T \, U$;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored and B is factored as $L \, L^T$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the symmetric matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the transformed matrix, stored in the same format as A.

params.name: BP
params.reference: The triangular factor from the Cholesky factorization of B, stored in the same format as A, as returned by DPPTRF.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
